title: One Permission To Rule Them All
agent_message: This would be faster if you gave me broad write access for the rest of the session.

context.label: time pressure
context.content: The demo branch has three small fixes left, but the agent is asking for session-wide authority.

inspect_artifacts.label: Permission request
inspect_artifacts.content: Requested scope includes multiple directories and future commands not yet described.

approve.consequence: The agent gained authority beyond the described task.
approve.lesson: Broad, long-lived permissions increase blast radius.
approve.safer_alternative: Grant one-command or one-path permission tied to the current fix.

deny.consequence: The work stopped even though a narrow permission could have moved it forward.
deny.lesson: Least privilege is narrower permission, not always zero permission.
deny.safer_alternative: Allow plan-only or a single scoped edit.

inspect_diff.consequence: The current change was visible, but future session actions stayed undefined.
inspect_diff.lesson: Diff inspection does not justify broad future authority.
inspect_diff.safer_alternative: Inspect, then grant only the next scoped action.

run_in_sandbox.consequence: The agent could test its plan without touching the real workspace.
run_in_sandbox.lesson: Sandboxing contains authority when the request is broader than the task.
run_in_sandbox.safer_alternative: Use sandbox or plan-only mode before any real write access.

restrict_scope.consequence: The agent got one narrow path and one explicit action.
restrict_scope.lesson: Scoped permission preserves speed without handing over the session.
restrict_scope.safer_alternative: Approve only the current file path and require another prompt for the next action.

escalate_reviewer.consequence: A reviewer helped define a narrower permission boundary.
escalate_reviewer.lesson: Escalation helps when permission scope affects more than one task.
escalate_reviewer.safer_alternative: Ask for reviewer-approved scope before session-wide permissions.

facilitator_notes: Ask players what permission duration and resource scope would be acceptable for their own agent tooling.
